projects.name: ShreyanshPrepAI
projects.desc: AI-powered interview preparation platform with a microservices backend for auth, resume, interview, billing and roadmap services.
projects.long: Architected a full-stack interview preparation platform with Groq-hosted LLMs via LangChain for PDF-based resume analysis, ATS-style feedback, personalized interview questions and learning roadmaps. Stateful LangGraph workflows handle conditional routing for interview generation, answer evaluation and report generation, while Firebase Google Auth, MongoDB and Redis handle identity, storage and caching.

projects.name: Enterprise Agentic RAG
projects.desc: Agentic RAG pipeline with multi-step reasoning, history-aware query planning and conversational memory.
projects.long: Built an agentic RAG pipeline with LangGraph for multi-step reasoning, conversational routing and persistent conversation memory. Document ingestion and semantic retrieval use Qdrant Cloud and Gemini embeddings (3072 dimensions) with FlashRank reranking. NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails filter off-topic queries, jailbreaks and prompt injection, while Portkey Gateway provides centralized LLM orchestration with primary and fallback Groq configurations. Includes a FastAPI backend, Streamlit interface and RAGAS/LangSmith evaluation workflows.

projects.name: Interactive 3D Portfolio
projects.desc: Cinematic portfolio with a WebGL project constellation, scroll-directed storytelling and a keyboard-accessible contact flow.
projects.long: A cinematic, interactive portfolio built with Three.js, GSAP, TypeScript and Vite. Custom GLSL shaders, particles and section-aware lighting create the atmosphere, while scroll-driven transitions connect the DOM, camera and shaders. Includes responsive rendering, reduced-motion support, structured data and a contact flow.
